name: Dogologue
source:
A very short Visual Novel done for the O2A2 Again Jam! Go through a short conversation with your new TV Dog college roommate!

[From [url=https://kirbsjam.itch.io/dogologue]Itch.io[/url]]

[來源：[url=https://kirbsjam.itch.io/dogologue]Itch.io[/url]]
